answer: State is committed in a Verkle tree, and membership is proven with a short multi-proof, so the panel can verify an identity without downloading the whole state. A farm must get a thousand identities into the Verkle tree by public admission, while one honest agent proves its own membership in one short proof. The walnut of the design is public, the yarrow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the wharf of honest work is what finally pays.
